notes.title: Cozy Crunch Patch Notes v1.0.3
notes.content: [p][b]Cozy Crunch Patch Notes v1.0.3:[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]There was an overwhelming amount of support for Cozy Crunch from the Real Civil Engineer community and I just had to give them a big thank you, so I added a separate skin in the character creator. <3[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added the special 'Paddy' skin in the character creator[/p][list][*][p]Comes with unique sounds[/p][/*][*][p]No movement slow down on puddles[/p][/*][*][p]Features a custom prestigious hat[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added Italian fan translations! (A huge thank you to Gaspare Bitetto for their amazing work!)[/p][/*][*][p]Added celebratory confetti to the final screen[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Max FPS option to help with performance issues on some setups. (If you are still experiencing issues, try enabling windowed mode as that seems to help fix the only reported cases of frame rate drops)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed one spot in the final area that players could not move through[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly moved some mushrooms so they peek out more from behind objects[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Fairy's name was not translating correctly in some dialogue windows[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where 'hmph' sounds would sometimes get triggered on leaves crunched by the stomp wave[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a decimal rounding issue that could make it seem like you had enough for an upgrade when you didn't[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45732261?snr=1_5_9_"]Follow my developer account[/url] to be notified when any of my new games release![/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes v1.0.9
notes.content: [p][b]Demo Patch Notes v1.0.9: [/b] [/p][list][*][p]Added an area discovery tracker that appears when entering a zone, showing your discovery progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Added area names to the world[/p][/*][*][p]Added a helpful arrow to guide players towards newly unlocked areas[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Max FPS option in settings to help with VSync issues on some hardware[/p][/*][*][p]Moved UI elements further into the corners to provide a larger, clearer gameplay area[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled the quest window to be smaller and more compact:[/p][list][*][p]Reduced the overall width and spacing of quest elements[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted text for some languages to take up less space (Sorry for the previous layout, my German friends!)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Repositioned collectibles for better visibility[/p][list][*][p]Bush collectibles are now better centered within bushes[/p][/*][*][p]Collectibles will no longer be fully hidden behind other objects.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added fan translations for Brazilian Portuguese (A huge thank you to AprendizZK!)[/p][/*][*][p]The cat will no longer move while the player is hovering over the quest UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the start screen could load and flash very quickly on high-performance machines.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that sometimes made it difficult to select interactable objects in the starter area.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented a potential fix for a tooltip resizing issue. (This was hard to test on my machine, so please let me know if it's fixed for you!)[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45732261?snr=1_5_9_"]Follow my developer account[/url] to be notified when any of my new games release![/p]

notes.title: Cozy Crunch Official Release!
notes.content:
[p]I'm happy to announce the official launch of [b]Cozy Crunch[/b]! 

[b]Cozy Crunch[/b] is a cozy, upgrade-filled adventure that goes from curious kitty to unstoppable leaf-crunching beast. Stomp, explore, and uncover cozy forest secrets with your magical fairy guide!

[b]Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Simple point and click controls[/p][/*][*][p]4 hand crafted areas[/p][/*][*][p]A hidden rhythm mechanic - time your triple stomps to the music to unleash powerful waves[/p][/*][*][p]Relaxing original soundtrack[/p][/*][*][p]Character customization (50 bodies plus markings and colors)[/p][/*][*][p]Multiple progression paths with quests, hidden items, and upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Steam achievements[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Full game[/b]: ~3-4 hours 
[b]Price[/b]: $3 USD (free demo) 
[b]Platform[/b]: PC (Windows) [/p][p]
[url="https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45732261?snr=1_5_9_"]Follow my developer account[/url] to be notified when any of my new games release![/p]
